fixtures.input: This is an extraordinarily long message designed specifically to exceed the maximum tokenizer limit of one hundred and twenty eight tokens. In a peer-to-peer epidemic mesh chat system, messages are chunked, encrypted, and routed hop-by-hop across mobile handsets without servers. When a user enters a long paragraph, the WordPiece tokenizer must greedily segment every word into subwords and truncate strictly to one hundred and twenty eight tokens. The first token must always be the classification token CLS with ID 101, and the final non-padded token must always be the separation token SEP with ID 102. Even when the raw text spans multiple sentences and hundreds of vocabulary tokens, safety and stability require deterministic bounded execution. Additional filler words: mesh bluetooth central peripheral advertiser scanner gatt service characteristic uuid payload epoch rotation.
